$comment: Shared behaviour corpus for the direct-write branch of the concurrency gate.
Two independent detectors implement it — eslint-rules/concurrency-guard.js (ESTree)
and scripts/codemods/concurrency-guard/ast.ts (ts-morph). Both are run over every
case below by their focused suites. `expected` lists findings in source order; an
empty list means no finding. Add a case here rather than to one suite when changing
which direct calls either detector recognises. Path exemptions are tested separately.

cases.name: delegate alias behind a satisfies expression at the call site
delegate alias initialized through a satisfies expression
delegate alias behind a non-null expression at the call site
renamed destructured delegate alias
no-substitution template member is not a static name
dynamic computed mutator names no method
let-bound delegate is not treated as a stable alias
identifier spelled exactly as a gated delegate is reported
cases.code:
export {};
const write = ({ characterStats }) => characterStats.update({ where: { characterId }, data });

cases.name: renamed destructured function parameter is not a const alias
cases.code:
export {};
const write = ({ characterStats: stats }) => stats.update({ where: { characterId }, data });
